function.name: telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get
function.description: Retrieves specified telemetry information for a network interface within a given fabric, node, and pod, filtered by the interface and information types. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit the nodes pertaining to the given fabric name.

nodeId.description: The identifier of the node to limit the results pertaining to the given node ID.

podId.description: The identifier of the pod to limit the results pertaining to the given pod ID.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit the results pertaining to the given interface type.

infoType.description: The type of information to retrieve about the interface.

message.content:
### How to Retrieve Interface Information via Telemetry

The telemetry API provides a single, well‑defined function that lets you pull any of the four supported data types (`interfaces`, `status`, `statistics`, `errors`) for a specific interface type on a particular node/pod in a fabric.

```python
# Import the function (the actual import path depends on your SDK)
from functions import telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get

# Call the function with the required parameters
result = telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get(
    fabricName="myFabric",      # Name of the fabric
    nodeId=123,                 # Node ID (integer)
    podId=1,                    # Pod ID (integer)
    interfaceType="ethernet",   # One of: svi, ethernet, loopback, port-channel
    infoType="statistics"       # One of: interfaces, status, statistics, errors
)

print(result)
```

#### Parameter Breakdown

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `fabricName` | `string` | The fabric name that scopes the query. |
| `nodeId` | `number` | The numeric ID of the node you’re interested in. |
| `podId` | `number` | The numeric ID of the pod (if applicable). |
| `interfaceType` | `"svi" | "ethernet" | "loopback" | "port-channel"` | The type of interface you want data for. |
| `infoType` | `"interfaces" | "status" | "statistics" | "errors"` | The kind of information you want to retrieve. |

#### Common Use Cases

| Goal | Example `infoType` |
|------|--------------------|
| List all interfaces on a node | `"interfaces"` |
| Get the operational status of an interface | `"status"` |
| Pull traffic counters (bytes, packets, errors) | `"statistics"` |
| Retrieve error counters (CRC, alignment, etc.) | `"errors"` |

#### Quick Example: Get Ethernet Statistics on Node 42, Pod 3

```python
stats = telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get(
    fabricName="prodFabric",
    nodeId=42,
    podId=3,
    interfaceType="ethernet",
    infoType="statistics"
)
print(stats)
```

The returned object will contain the telemetry data in JSON format (or whatever format your SDK uses). You can then parse it, store it, or feed it into monitoring dashboards.

---

**Tip:** If you’re unsure of the exact `nodeId` or `podId`, you can first query the fabric’s inventory or use a discovery endpoint to list all nodes/pods before calling this function.
